profile.headline: Lead Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have been developing Ruby applications for over six years at a non-profit called Fractured Atlas. We help artists focus on their art by developing applications for the business side of their work. Our engineering team is remote and I am accustomed to working in this environment.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: • Currently migrating CI/CD pipelines from CircleCI to GitHub Actions, reducing build times and cutting monthly infrastructure costs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
• Designed and shipped a home page search overlay, boosting CTR +116% and significantly increasing ad engagement
• Implemented second inventory search ad feature which increased TAM by over 70%
• Built GraphQL API for ad data, enabling native app integration via SDUI and driving +34% revenue and +88% CTR
• Used Mikado Method to transition home page requests to use a directed acyclic graph data structure leading to reduced latency
• Introduced conditional logging, eliminating millions of unnecessary log calls and cut infrastructure costs by thousands per month
• Added Telemetry data for both Google Ad Manager and Koddi ad networks resulting in quicker response times to issues

positions.title: Elixir Engineer
positions.description: • Published blockchain transactions to Polygon network and queried transaction data from theGraph to resolve user issues

positions.title: Elixir Engineer
positions.description:
• Decomposed monolith into Phoenix-based microservices, improving scalability and maintainability
• Optimized SQL queries using PEV, reducing query latency and improving platform performance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented a profile expiration coordinator with a GenServer process
• Built permission system for archive/restore/delete user profile functionality

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Platform modernization: Ported PHP → Rails fundraising platform that raised $5.5M for artists
• Frontend: Componentized frontend with Elm for reusable campaign feature
• Systems/Integrations: Built RESTful APIs (Sinatra, Grape, Rack), integrated payment gateways
• Leadership: Collaborated with PMs to set scope/timelines

positions.title: Gold Options Market Maker
positions.description:
• Traded option volatility looking for arbitrage opportunities.
• Managed and analyzed risks associated with an options position.
• Priced options using Black-Scholes option price theory model, including the Greeks, volatility smile and put/call skew

positions.title: Trading Assistant/Floor Clerk
positions.description:
• Managed risk for as many as five options market makers.
• Liaison between trading floor and futures clearing merchants. 
• Ensured all trades were properly executed and allocated. 
• Researched and resolved trade discrepancies, ensured all trades were booked and matched with appropriate counter-party.
